title: Cost analysis conformance fixture
description: One differential-oracle case: a schema, an operation, optional variables and the expected IBM typeCost/fieldCost pair.

id.description: A stable, file-name-safe identifier for this fixture.

sdl.description: The schema document, including the @cost and @listSize directive declarations.

operation.description: The operation document, including any fragments it spreads.

operationName.description: The operation to execute within the document, or null for an anonymous operation.

variables.description: The supplied variable values, or null for the static (variable-free) bound.

defaultListSize.description: The CostEngineOptions.DefaultListSize used to compile this fixture.

backend.description: The traversal backend this fixture's expected values were computed with.
